text: Oh, can you believe we actually did it? We made it through the storm. Wind howling, rain lashing. I thought we'd never see the sun again. There were nights, nights I cried myself to sleep, whispering, is anyone even out there? But then you showed up. You smiled and suddenly the world wasn't so dark. I felt seen, understood. Then builds, remember that silly dance in the kitchen with burnt pancakes? Oh, we were a mess. But now, now you've gone. The silence is deafening. I miss you every single day. But I carry you with me in every laugh, every tear, every quiet moment. And I'll keep going because that's what you would want, always.
